bermuda.title: Flag of Bermuda

colors.note: The coat of arms depicting a lion holding a shipwreck.

desc: - A Red Ensign with the coat of arms of Bermuda in the fly
- The arms depict a red lion holding a shield showing a sinking ship, representing the wreck of the Sea Venture in 1609
trivia:
- The lion on the shield holds a key, symbolising Bermuda's strategic location in Atlantic trade routes
- Bermuda's flag features the Union Jack, reflecting its status as a British Overseas Territory
- The red is said to reference the red earth found on Bermuda's beaches
